featured.author: Customer in Greater London
featured.text: I had a range of services from Thorburn Landscapes, including re-turfing the lawn, tidying and planting in the borders, reducing a patio wall (including rendering) and re-grouting the patio. Firstly, I’m really pleased with the work, I think it looks great. Rui and the team were always very friendly, polite and professional - making sure we were up to date with what the plan was for each day and providing clear instructions on post care maintenance (which was also followed up over email by the office). The work was quoted to take 7 days and they finished under budget in 5 days. I had one query following completion about the finish on the patio tiles, which was rectified quickly. Would recommend and would definitely use again.

featured.author: Verified reviewer
featured.text: Thorburn landscapes did a great job and my garden is just how I want it. I met with Stephen to discuss some ideas I had and came up with a great plan. The team was very friendly, hard working and diligent throughout the project. The cost worked out a bit more than I was hoping but the finished garden is amazing and would not hesitate to recommend them.

featured.author: Customer in Greater London
featured.text: Thorburn Landscapes recently laid a new lawn for me in North Kingston. The work was carried out with great efficiency by Flavio and Rui who completed it in the quoted two days with exemplary commitment, courtesy and professionalism. We are delighted with the result and we consider that both they and the lawn itself are a credit to Thorburn Landscapes.

featured.author: Verified reviewer
featured.text: I am so pleased that I discovered Stephen. The transformation in our garden is incredible. I would never have imagined that that scruffy, sloping bit of our garden could become a beautiful place to sit and to entertain. He totally exceeded our expectations of what was possible. The team who worked in our garden were extremely polite, non-invasive and helpful and the standard of their work is very high with so much care and attention to detail. I would have no hesitation in recommending this company to anyone. We are delighted.

featured.author: Customer in Greater London
featured.text: I cannot praise Stephen and his men highly enough. His suggestions for repurposing the end of my garden were perfect and I am delighted with the result. They completed the job well within time and within budget. They were very friendly, polite and considerate. They worked very hard, there was no radio and not a sign of a mobile phone! Everything left tidy at the end of the day. It was very easy to communicate with Stephen or his secretary. He was most persistent in following up missing piece on the summerhouse. I would strongly recommend his company.

featured.author: Verified reviewer
featured.text: Very easy to communicate with Thorburn over email (which is preferable for me) - was the first time we've used them, our front and back garden needed a thorough clean up. We were away on the day, but coming home to the work being done as agreed was great. Even though I gave a detailed description of what we required, they said they would also tidy up anything else they see that needs done on the day. This was done and within their estimate. We have already booked to use them again, purely because they are so easy to deal with - but book early, they're busy and I'm not surprised.

projects.title: Kingston Garden Update: Entertainment Garden
projects.summary: This garden in Coombe Rise (Kingston / New Malden) featured tired old decking and an underused layout that lacked structure and charm. The space needed a contemporary refresh to create a more functional and sociable environment for entertaining.

projects.title: Courtyard Garden Renovation in Clapham/Battersea: Full Garden Design
projects.summary: This Clapham/Battersea courtyard had become overgrown, neglected, and uninviting. With old fences, no clear seating areas, and a lack of structure, the garden was in need of a complete transformation to create a welcoming space for both relaxation and entertaining.

projects.title: Garden Renovation in Wimbledon: Full Garden Design & Landscpaing
projects.summary: This Wimbledon garden had become a tired and outdated space, lacking structure, flow, and purpose. The owners were looking for a complete garden transformation that would not only update the space, but also create a more enjoyable, relaxing environment to spend time in.

projects.title: Garden Design Wimbledon
projects.summary: This Wimbledon garden had become overgrown and out of control, lacking structure, purpose, and year-round interest. It needed a complete garden redesign to create a more usable, beautiful outdoor space that would feel connected to nature and be enjoyable throughout the seasons.
